game.name: Rainbow Six Vegas 2 (Germany)
game.desc:
Rainbow Six Vegas 2 on Xbox 360 is a first-person tactical shooter that you play as Bishop, leader of a Rainbow squad. The action takes place in the city of vice, Las Vegas, where you are in pursuit of terrorists and the truth, following the events of the first opus.
To deal with the situation as effectively as possible, you have a variety of weapons and outfits at your disposal. End the Vegas crisis... Definitely.
